items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: one of the comedians Pigmeat said, come here. I said, hey, what do you say

ctx.x: No, he was a good tenor player. Now, all around the same size, like Ben Webster. So one day I'm going up to the Apollo Theater, said, I'll stop at the bar and talk with the fellows in the performance. So I saw all this crowd stopping by (unintelligible) near the back end of the Apollo Theater

on 126th towards Sixth Street. So (unintelligible) said, say, Hap, one of the comedians Pigmeat said, come here. I said, hey, what do you say, (unintelligible). Why don't you go (unintelligible) them cats are? I said, about what? Who is it? Said, them three old B's. We called them the three B's -- Bob Dorsey, Ben Webster and --- I said, who? He said, the three B's up there. I said, oh, Lord, said, I ain't going to get in this.
